timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹457.92 Cr (+7.0% YoY), net profit ₹33.98 Cr (+72.2% YoY).
Vardhman Special Steels commissioned a new reheating furnace taking capacity to 270,000 MT and detailed plans for a 500,000 MTPA greenfield plant by FY30.
Vardhman Special Steels Limited shared the audio recording link for its Q4 & FY2026 earnings conference call held on 29-April-2026 at 11:00 a.m.
Vardhman Special Steels raised FY27 EBITDA guidance to ₹8,000–11,000/t and targeted 250,000 tonnes sales volume.
Sachit Jain declared under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) that Vardhman Special Steels’ promoters and their concert parties did not encumber their shares during FY 2025-26.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹600.05 Cr (+38.8% YoY), net profit ₹52.49 Cr (+51.9% YoY).
